CHALLENGE R17-P3-01 and R17-P1-01, both mine. AMENDMENT-22 published "At this head, on the real pack, that count is 23 of 23" for a sentence meant to make an inert anchor visible. The figure was measured before b49d612 existed (the head prints 24), and the count itself was false: _marker_revs.add(_r2) sat inside the PATH-discovery loop, so every path-discovered revision was credited to the marker leg and the count could never be low. git log --no-renames -G on the marker answers 1 of 24 on the real pack, and a world whose marker leg matched nothing printed 2 of 2. column3: CHALLENGE R18-P1-01, mine. AMENDMENT-23 published "57 artifact rows + the manifest, 57 files, 24 revisions" under "Measured AT the pushed head". 24 is the PARENT b49d612 figure; at c001cd9 git rev-list HEAD -- :(top)phase-preparation/phase14/P14-HANDOFF-MANIFEST.md answers 25, because the commit that publishes the amendment modifies the manifest and so adds the revision being counted. Rows, files and the marker count reproduced exactly. The rule this adds: measuring after the last document write is enough for digests, row counts and file counts, and is NOT enough for any number derived from history; re-measure that in a clone of the pushed head.
